games.name: [⏰FASHIONABLY LATE] Die of Death
games.desc:
Earlier update log: Fashionably Late Update. This update includes tons of new major content and reworks. Nearly everything in the game has been changed up to some extent, check it out!
UPDATE LOG: A small bit of content and a TON of bug fixes and rebalancings. This is the most bug fixes Die of Death has gotten in any update ever! Intention behind this patch is to fix up the game back to its glory again.

Die of Death is a notably inconsistent game when it comes to strategy and often requires adapting on the fly to win. This game does an unique spin on the asymmetrical-horror genre, taking a more light and unserious tone when it comes to its content & gameplay! Randomness is a key factor here, with gamemodes that appear in between matches, random ability decks survivors are forced to pick in order to live, and more!

NOTHING IN THIS GAME FINAL, EXPECT CHANGES IN THE FUTURE!

games.name: bridger: WESTERN (CMOON)
games.desc:
Mankind in their expansion west have settled within Ridge. B Valley, a grueling and untouched wilderness rumored to hold an ancient curse. Beasts hunt and forces beyond mortal reach skulk these grounds, their chaos trapped and anchored by those who came long before them.

Your place within the valley is yet to be decided,  whatever path you choose to walk down danger remains a constant.

-Basic Controls-
Q - Quick dash 
W+W - Sprint 
R - Reload (With Weapon)
M1 - Fire (With weapon)
M2 - Aim in (With weapon) 
G - Melee (With weapon)
X - Ocular Prowess 
C - Fists 
F - Block (With fists out)
M - Statistics Menu 
H - Summon/Unsummon horse
N - Ride horse/Dismount

MAKE SURE TO HAVE A CLIPPING SOFTWARE SUCH AS MEDAL, SHADOWPLAY ETC IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO BE UNBANNED FROM ANTICHEAT.
(This game is in Early Alpha, meaning that everything is work in progress, and subject to change.)
